name: Stormwind City
_terrain: A 3.3.5 city Turtle changed lightly: Turtle's Stormwind and harbor are the same WotLK buildings 3.3.5 has (same WMOs, same places); Turtle added Davenburg, a small Kul Tiras settlement in the harbor's north-east shipyard (its own buildings kttown/ktfarm), and new NPCs and quests across the city. The 3.3.5 city, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's additions are merged in.
_merge_region: own=changed: only Davenburg's 12 chunks (area id only, ground within 0.5 yd) and the one city chunk Turtle reshaped that the Northwind build did not already take (tiles 29_47/30_47 are built on Northwind's shipped tiles). reshaped=none: nothing outside the city. 3.3.5's WotLK icebreaker hulls and the hangar stay (their origins are outside Davenburg).
_extra_creature_templates: The three quest_40660_dummy_triger credit creatures of 'Controlling Sailors' (no spawns).
_exclude_creatures: Turtle systems (C++ or custom items/spells): Baron Bobby (shop refunds), Bustus (title_masker), Isabella Locksley (hair dyes: Turtle cosmetic items), Felicia and Ophelia Worthington (Turtle's transmogrification and its 'Fashion Demands Sacrifices' quests), the Shellcoin scene (Distraught/Very Sad Investor, Shell Co Lobbyist), the bounty-board quest dummy (Slay the Honorable/Dishonorable), the rented horses (rented_mount), Teller Plushner (Turtle's guild vault), Tolif Valanor (Turtle companion pets), Valiant (Turtle's Stormwind tabard and armored warhorse), Marven and Heartclaw (pet trainer: 3.3.5 has no pet training), the Fencer family (Turtle's own Jewelcrafting: its recipes and supplies are Turtle spells and items).
_exclude_gameobjects: Wanted: Vile Criminal! (bounty board), Shell Co has relocated! (Shellcoin), Stormwind Fashion House (transmogrification sign), the fountain's sparkling coin (go_stormwind_fountain: Turtle's collectible coins), the High Elf survival tent (Survival profession), Speedy's Jukebox (go_radio), the Gardening Zone Checks (Turtle gardening), Turtle's barbershop chairs (3.3.5 has its own barbershop in the same place), the Fencer Family Jewels sign.
_exclude_quests: Turtle systems: 39980/39981 (bounty board), 39986-39989 (Shellcoin), 60030-60036 (transmogrification). Quests of Turtle content elsewhere (their other end is not ported): 40273 (started by the Uncommon Journal in Hillsbrad), 40514 (Lady Meldralis Windsong in Ironforge), 40599-40601 (The Old Church of Westfall VII-IX: I-VI are Turtle Westfall), 40794 (Lieutenant Alverold in the Barrens), 41134 (Daisy Windhelm's hunter chain in Elwynn, ends at Marven), 41268-41270 (Vera Lauren's Winter Veil chain), 41347/41348/41352 (Countess Tillia Earlwake in Karazhan), 80700 and 80708 (the SI:7 / Thandol Span / Scarlet chain left out with the Wetlands). 'at' puts the start node on Steelwing (Turtle's node is 3.6 yd away; the core starts a scripted flight only within 10 yd of its node).
